{{Quote|A Jedi healer, whose sacrifice, unlike his name, has not been forgotten, developed a shielding technique to release Morrhage's hold on his victims.|Jedi Master [[Chamma]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''Jedi healer''' was crucial in [[Terrak Morrhage conflict|defeating]] the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Terrak Morrhage]], developing a [[shielding technique]] with which he severed Morrhage's victims of the [[Dark Plague]] from the Sith's influence. Each usage of the ritual cost the individual some strength, however, and he eventually drove himself to [[Death/Legends|death]].
